Create a monthly budget plan for my [type of business] with [approximate revenue range]. My fixed costs are: [list — e.g., "SaaS tools, rent, insurance"]. My variable costs are: [list — e.g., "contractors, ad spend, travel"]. I want to allocate budget across: operations, marketing, savings/emergency fund, owner's pay, and reinvestment.
Give me: (1) A recommended percentage breakdown for each category based on my revenue, (2) A monthly budget template I can fill in (markdown table), (3) Warning signs that my spending is off track, (4) 3 specific cost-cutting ideas for a [type of business] at my stage.
